checklist: Resolve exact registered repository and inspect current Git state
Read local agent contract, active OpenSpec change and requirement IDs
Reuse verified components and project commands
Record capabilities, acceptance criteria and documentation impact

checklist: Use project-isolated credential references and synthetic test data
Run affected secret/privacy checks and preserve custom work
Record command, exit code, input revision, artifact and status
Update affected source/PDF inventory, review intended diff and commit when gates pass
required_checks: No fabricated approval, consent, tests or deployment

checklist: Translate the business request into explicit acceptance scenarios
Discover applicable capabilities from the actual project
Implement the smallest complete change with living comments
Validate, fix diagnosed failures, document and record the next action
required_checks: Acceptance criteria linked to observed evidence

checklist: Use project theme tokens and approved reusable controls
For compatible React projects assess shadcn/ui and existing primitives; preserve established stack
Cover loading, empty, error, permission and success states
Preserve branded footer, accessible labels, focus, keyboard and touch behavior
Record content ownership and need for a nontechnical editor

Model pages, media, SEO, locales, drafts, publishing and content history

Keep financial rules, secrets and business transaction records outside unrestricted page content

checklist: Define authoritative formula, units, effective date, assumptions and rounding rules
Create one deterministic versioned calculation module shared by API, UI and reports
Use decimal arithmetic for money; serialize decimals as strings or minor units
Validate input schemas, finite values, ranges, division and overflow
Record formula version and assumptions with each result; require reviewed publication of rule changes
required_checks: Golden input/output cases from authoritative requirements

checklist: Use the project's existing formatter/linter/type checker
Assess Biome for compatible JS/TS new baselines; preserve needed ESLint plugins
Keep explanatory headers above every modified routine and comments on decisions/data flow
Pin versions and lock dependencies; avoid repo-wide formatting churn
Maintain explicit API/schema contracts and server-side authorization
Use forward-only migrations and reproducible synthetic seeds
Use project-isolated storage and parameterized queries
Document transaction and backup/recovery behavior
required_checks: Recovery and encryption checks when sensitive storage is affected

checklist: Keep mobile layout, safe areas, styled controls and branded footer
Verify tab history, sub-state dismissal and root exit confirmation
Test encryption, masking, offline outbox, sync and purge behavior
Maintain complete screen/action inventory and physical wireless ADB evidence
Inspect actual project workflow and sanitized runtime execution
Check session isolation, trained override precedence and deterministic response boundaries
Validate opt-in and message compliance for messaging
Use project-local diagnostics; preserve core FAQs and client isolation
Resolve declared enabled project/environment identity
Build reproducible release with rollback and project-owned deployment script
Complete affected tests, security gates and current handover outputs
Perform remote changes only when deployment is in the user's requested scope
required_checks: Observed public health and product smoke flows
Rollback evidence and explicit unverified gaps
Complete security-release recipe before both UAT and production

checklist: Resolve all applicable dependency, container/OS, configuration, secret, source, DAST and host security coverage
Use Trivy and OSV-Scanner for supported dependencies, image Trivy/Grype for containers, Gitleaks for secrets and authorized isolated ZAP for web/API
Fix every confirmed applicable finding at every severity, rebuild and re-scan the final artifact
Bind evidence to source revision, immutable artifact, configuration, scanner/database version and target environment
Block UAT and production when any required check or remediation is missing; a core collector report alone is not release approval
required_checks: Zero unresolved confirmed applicable findings at all severities
No ignore-unfixed, blanket suppressions or unsupported-scan green result
Current artifact-bound full release gate before remote mutation

checklist: Developers and agents own pre-delivery testing; client UAT follows verified engineering checks
Generate the applicable capability test matrix and discover actual project-owned commands
Support visible and headless browser modes with explicit mode selection and equivalent acceptance cases
Assess current compatible FOSS tools, pin verified versions and retain dated evidence
Record actual execution and all missing tests; do not label a plan or unavailable suite as passed
required_checks: All relevant unit, integration, functional, security, negative, calculation, accessibility, responsive, offline, recovery, performance and release cases
Both browser modes for applicable UI release verification
Explicit BLOCKED state for missing environments or required tests
